name: Jasmine Ali

behavioral_observations.observation: Re-introduces the Premium Analytics module every two to three weeks; will pivot framing (cost-saving / risk-reducing / sponsor-impressing) depending on audience.
Goes silent on integration-sprint slippage unless directly named.

notes: Vendor PM. Targets in her contract are tied to module-upsell as well as on-time delivery; the upsell push is structural, not personal.
